description:
The gf2-coding example that renders presentation figures writes into `docs/presentations/figures/`, a permanent path that holds no decks. It writes to a caller-chosen directory instead.

## Background

Writer: `crates/gf2-coding/examples/gen_presentation_figures.rs:12-18,39`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The example writes only to an output directory the caller supplies, defaulting to a path under `target/`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Running the example writes nothing under `docs/`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The example's header states its purpose and output location in one short paragraph.
- [hard] REQ-04: The Rust CI gate passes.
title: Point the presentation figure example at a caller-chosen output dir
